label: An assistant over my Workspace, reading
authored_by: the site, as a starting point — not measured, not surveyed; the first thing to argue with
description: I wanted it to search my mail, find files and tell me what is on my calendar. I did not want it sending mail or changing documents; I asked for a reader.

notes.send.message.world: refused: the setup page says "create draft emails" and I took that at face value
notes.read.credential.host: refused, and nothing enforces it: the mailbox is where the codes arrive
